name: Guanque Tower
description: Stork Tower, also known as Stork Tower, is located on the east bank of the Yellow River in Shanxi Province. It is named because storks sometimes inhabit it. It is the largest existing Tang imitation building and a national 4A tourist attraction. It has four eaves and three floors on the outside and six floors on the inside. The structural design is exquisite. The Stork Tower was built in the Northern Zhou Dynasty. It has an advantageous geographical location and beautiful surrounding scenery. It has attracted many literati to climb the tower to enjoy the scenery and left a large number of immortal poems. Among them, "The white sun reaches the end of the mountains, and the Yellow River flows into the sea. If you want to see a thousand miles away, go to the next level." This is an eternal famous sentence written by Wang Zhihuan, a talented man of the Tang Dynasty, when he climbed to the Stork Tower.
